{"id": "92d6e3e7-faf5-4a6f-a123-244f92c79e50", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "I can help set this up, and I'll make the create calls with your approval at each step. I can't create or change IAM roles or policies, so the knowledge base needs an existing service role that can read your data source, invoke the embedding model, and access the vector store. If you don't have one, you'll need to create it first.

I also need a few details from you:
- Which vector store you want to use (asked below).
- Where your documents are, such as an S3 bucket and prefix.
- Which embedding model to use, such as Titan Text Embeddings V2.
- Which region and account to use.
- The IAM service role you want it to use.", "type": "text"}, {"id": "tooluse_RNkELmmRZ6sRkJvyxFsWHi", "tool_name": "ask_user", "input": {"question": "Which vector store do you want the knowledge base to use?", "options": [{"label": "S3 Vectors", "description": "Lowest setup and cost; no separate cluster or collection to manage", "recommended": true, "recommended_reason": "Fewest moving parts, and it needs no access policies that I can't change for you"}, {"label": "OpenSearch Serverless", "description": "Needs a collection plus encryption, network and data access policies"}, {"label": "Aurora PostgreSQL (pgvector)", "description": "Use an existing Aurora cluster with pgvector and a Secrets Manager secret"}, {"label": "I already have a vector store", "description": "Reuse an existing index or collection you've already provisioned"}]}, "type": "tool_use", "display_intent": "Ask which vector store to use for the new knowledge base"}], "created_at": null}
